_meta.description: Graph of internal and external dependencies (Maven + npm) — Digitální archiv AMČR

root.description: Main package — servlets, configuration, helper classes

SearchServlet.responsibility: HTTP servlet for search — central entry point for all queries

Options.responsibility: Singleton configuration — loads and merges JSON configuration from files

InitServlet.responsibility: Lifecycle servlet — initialization of I18n, Solr clients, temp directories

AuthService.responsibility: User authentication via the external AMČR API

fedora.description: Communication with the Fedora Repository REST API — harvesting and models

FedoraHarvester.responsibility: Harvests records from Fedora and indexes them into Solr

FedoraUtils.responsibility: HTTP client for the Fedora API — authorization, file downloads

fedora.models.description: Data models of AMČR entities (Akce, Dokument, Projekt, Lokalita, etc.)
fedora.models.note: The models are hydrated from Fedora's JSON responses; they have no internal cross-dependencies (pure POJOs)

index.description: Solr indexing and search — SolrSearcher, IndexUtils, SearchUtils, specialized Searcher classes

SolrSearcher.responsibility: Central Solr query class — access-level management, facets, thesaurus

SearchUtils.responsibility: Factory and utilities for search — instantiation of Searcher classes, CSV/JSON conversion

IndexUtils.responsibility: Utilities for manipulating Solr documents — adding fields, security suffixes

imagging.description: Working with image files — access, MIME types, PDF
imagging.note: TYPO in the package name — it should be 'imaging'

oai.description: OAI-PMH protocol — metadata delivery for harvesters

scope_compile.concern: EOL_DEPENDENCY — Apache XML-RPC has been end-of-life since 2016; consider removal or replacement
OUTDATED — the project otherwise uses java.net.http (JDK 11+); consider unifying on a single HTTP client
NAMESPACE_MISMATCH — uses the old javax.mail namespace; Jakarta EE 11 requires jakarta.mail. Compatibility with the application server must be verified.

scope_compile.purpose: Wrapper for sending emails over javax.mail

scope_compile.concern: CRITICALLY_OUTDATED — Saxon 8.7 was released in 2006. The current version is Saxon-HE 12.x. ~18 years of security patches are missing. AGENTS.md documents XSLT 2.0/3.0, but Saxon 8.7 does not fully support XSLT 3.0.

scope_provided.purpose: Jakarta EE API (provided by the application server)

maven_plugins: maven-resources-plugin:3.4.0 — copies the Angular dist into webapp
com.google.code.maven-replacer-plugin:replacer:1.5.3 — injects JSP pageEncoding and context name
maven_dependencies.version_management_note: Dependency versions are managed directly in pom.xml without a parent POM or BOM. There is no centralized version management across modules.

thumbnails_generator_dependencies.concern: OUTDATED — ThumbnailsGenerator compiles for Java 1.8, while the main application targets Java 17.
thumbnails_generator_dependencies.note: Without a common parent POM — the versions of shared dependencies must be synchronized manually.

production.@angular/*: ^21.1.x — core framework, routing, forms, Material, SSR
production.@ngu/carousel: ^20.0.1 — carousel component (for Angular 20, the app is Angular 21)

concerns.issue: REDUNDANT — Angular HttpClient covers HTTP needs; axios increases bundle size
VERSION_MISMATCH — the carousel is for Angular 20, the application uses Angular 21
LEGACY — Moment.js is in maintenance mode. Migration to date-fns or the native Angular DatePipe is recommended

docker_service_dependencies.note: Docker and docker-compose files are not part of this repository (found in T01). Inter-service dependencies cannot be analyzed from this repository.

amcr_api.name: AMČR (aiscr-webamcr)
amcr_api.coupling: High — FedoraHarvester, FedoraUtils, and all models in fedora.models are directly bound to the AMČR API data model. An API version change requires modifications in many files.
amcr_api.version_negotiation: XSLT transformations for conversion between versions 2.0, 2.1, 2.2

fedora_repository.name: Fedora Repository
fedora_repository.role: Storage of digital objects and binary files

architectural_issues.title: God classes: SolrSearcher and FedoraHarvester
architectural_issues.description: SolrSearcher has 1,048 lines, FedoraHarvester has 1,024 lines. Both classes have an excessive number of responsibilities.
architectural_issues.recommendation: Refactor into smaller classes (Command pattern, Strategy pattern)

architectural_issues.title: Saxon 8.7 — critically outdated XSLT processor
architectural_issues.description: Saxon 8.7 from 2006 is critically outdated. The current version is Saxon-HE 12.x. ~18 years of missing security patches.
architectural_issues.recommendation: Upgrade to Saxon-HE 12.x (XSLT 3.0 support, active development)

architectural_issues.title: javax.mail in a Jakarta EE 11 project
architectural_issues.description: javax.mail:1.4.7 uses the old javax namespace. Jakarta EE 11 requires jakarta.mail. Possible classloading conflict.
architectural_issues.recommendation: Replace with jakarta.mail:jakarta.mail-api + Angus Mail implementation

architectural_issues.title: EOL dependency: Apache XML-RPC
architectural_issues.description: org.apache.xmlrpc:xmlrpc-client:3.1.3 — end-of-life since 2016, without security updates.

architectural_issues.title: ThumbnailsGenerator targets Java 1.8
architectural_issues.description: The main application targets Java 17, ThumbnailsGenerator targets Java 1.8.

architectural_issues.title: Axios vs Angular HttpClient — duplication
architectural_issues.description: The frontend contains both axios and Angular HttpClient. Two HTTP clients increase the bundle size.
architectural_issues.recommendation: Verify axios usage and migrate to Angular HttpClient

architectural_issues.title: Moment.js in maintenance mode
architectural_issues.description: Moment.js has been in maintenance mode since 2020.
architectural_issues.recommendation: Migrate to date-fns or the native Angular DatePipe

architectural_issues.title: No parent POM or BOM
architectural_issues.description: Shared dependencies must be synchronized manually between web/ and ThumbnailsGenerator/.
architectural_issues.recommendation: Add a root parent POM with dependencyManagement

architectural_issues.title: No automated Java tests
architectural_issues.description: The web/src/test directory does not exist. Already tracked in refactoring_backlog (T01).
architectural_issues.recommendation: Add JUnit 5 tests for key classes
